stops.name: Großes Walsertal
stops.quote: Großes Walsertal has been a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve since 2000.
stops.english: Großes Walsertal has been a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve since 2000.

stops.name: alpine dairy
stops.quote: Whether hiking, joining a guided nature or cultural experience, or visiting a traditional alpine dairy, there are many ways to discover the close relationship between the landscape, local farming and the way of life.
stops.english: Whether hiking, joining a guided nature or cultural experience, or visiting a traditional alpine dairy, there are many ways to discover the close relationship between the landscape, local farming and the way of life.

stops.name: core zone
stops.quote: Explore the core zone of the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve Großes Walsertal on a snowshoe hike
stops.english: Explore the core zone of the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve Großes Walsertal on a snowshoe hike

stops.name: Grosses Walsertal biosphere park
stops.quote: Ski and hiking tours in the Grosses Walsertal biosphere park take you to pristine mountain scenery
stops.english: Ski and hiking tours in the Grosses Walsertal biosphere park take you to pristine mountain scenery
